newsitem.title: USA: TWA to match Northwest Airlines fare cuts.
newsitem.headline: TWA to match Northwest Airlines fare cuts.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Friday it will match spring fare cuts announced late Thursday by Northwest Airlines Corp.

TWA said it will reduce some fares by as much as 50 percent to destinations in North America and Hawaii where the carrier competes with Northwest. Travel must be completed by September 3, the company said.
A 14-day advance purchase is required, and tickets must be bought within three days of making reservations, among other restrictions, TWA said.
TWA is the nation's seventh largest passenger airline.
Its shares were unchanged Friday at 5-15/16.
